rv.q: Remy Bumppo's BLUES FOR AN ALABAMA SKY is a triumph. Is it the writing, directing or acting? Yes! It doesn't get better than this production.
Remy Bumppo’s “Blues for An Alabama Sky” is a triumph.
If theatergoers want to experience a play that’s both priceless and powerful, and they’re ready, as Sam shouts, to “Let the good times roll,” don’t miss this terrific production.
Blues for an Alabama Sky is an enormously powerful play because Cleage's characters are so realistic and we know that the historical stakes for these people are high.
This cast, with crackling lead performances from Breon Arzell and Tiffany Renee Johnson, is more than up to the task, as is sure-footed director Mikael Burke.
Blues for an Alabama Sky is phenomenal.
This cast is brilliant and makes the two hours and forty minutes (with 1 intermission) move very quickly.
